The throwing authorization guard is `assertCan()` in `src/lib/permissions.ts` (as opposed to `can()`/`explain()`, which return a boolean/decision object). I searched every reference to `assertCan` across the repo and filtered out non-call sites: comments/doc mentions (invite-member-form.tsx, permission-gate.tsx, action-errors.ts), string-literal manifest listings (scripts/build-manifest.ts, scripts/manifest-parts/server.ts), a `vi.spyOn` reference and test files that exercise it directly (tests/*). What remains are the service-layer files that actually invoke `assertCan(...)` as a guard clause.

ANSWER: src/server/services/activity-service.ts, src/server/services/label-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/search-service.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/webhook-service.ts, src/server/services/attachment-service.ts, src/server/services/notification-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/organization-service.ts
